title: A bill to require the Federal Communications Commission to eliminate from its regulations the restrictions on the cross-ownership of broadcasting stations and newspapers.

actions.text: Sponsor introductory remarks on measure. (CR S3662-3663)
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce.

latest_action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce.

summaries.text: Requires the Federal Communications Commission to modify its regulations by eliminating any provisions limiting the granting or renewal of an AM, FM, or TV broadcast station license to any party (including parties under common control) on the basis of the ownership, operation, or control by such party of a daily newspaper.
